# The Forge

> A goal achievement app for Muslims who keep breaking the promises they make to themselves. It combines a written daily goal (the Creed), focus sessions that lock chosen distracting apps, and accountability from friends you choose who see every missed commitment.

Free to start with a 14-day trial; then The Iron Standard ($10/month or $102/year) or The Founding 20 ($20/month or $240/year, limited cohort). iPhone and Android (in beta as of October 2026). Payments on the website.

## What it does
- The Creed: a one-page goal (why, year, month, week, up to 3 tasks today) you read every morning; reading it is part of your streak.
- Commitments and focus sessions: during a session the apps you choose are blocked until the work is done.
- Accountability: two friends you trust see your commitments and every miss.
- Streaks and history of kept and missed commitments.

## Free tools
- [The Creed builder](https://jointheforge.app/creed/): write your one-page goal in 3 minutes.
- [The Gap Test](https://jointheforge.app/gap/): what you say matters to you, against the hours you actually give it.
- [The Sabr Fort](https://jointheforge.app/sabr/): Ibn al-Qayyim's ten reasons for patience against sin, with Arabic sources and a drill for each.

## Get it
- [Get the app](https://jointheforge.app/get/)
- [Join the waitlist / beta](https://jointheforge.app/join/)

## Alternatives people compare it with
stickK and Beeminder (commitment and accountability), Opal, one sec and Forest (app blocking and focus), Habitica and Streaks (habit streaks). The Forge differs by combining blocking, a written daily goal and friends who see your misses, built for Muslims.
